jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text: A principal engineer for the catalogue and workflow services. This is an individual contributor role with no reports and the last word on the group's technical direction.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text: • Twelve years or more building server side software, with at least three at a staff or principal level.

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
Pay

The base salary range for this position is $214,000 – $286,000 USD a year. Every offer at this level carries a target annual bonus of fifteen per cent of base salary.

Relocation support of $5,000 - $12,000 is available to anyone moving closer to an office.

This role is hybrid and expects two days a week in the Springfield office. We do not have a remote option for this position.

You must be legally authorised to work in the United States. Woodgrove does not sponsor visas for this position.
